_comment: Create adds no chapter of its own: KINETIC and BRASS sit in Matter, SPIN in Shapes & Force, through each word's 'chapter'. This entry extends the core 'making' group in place (same id), so the ribbon's blurb mentions the machines; it moves no chapter.

groups.blurb: Transmutation keeps an account of matter: stone, metal and decay, and the deeds that make, change and break. With Create installed, the motion of its machines is matter too. Summoning calls a helper from somewhere and sets it to work.
